text: uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho tasmā tiha bhikkhave se āyatane veditabbe yattha cakkhu ca nirujjhati rūpasaññā ca virajjati se āyatane veditabbe .pe. yattha mano ca nirujjhati dhammasaññā ca virajjati se āyatane veditabbeti . imassa khvāhaṃ āvuso bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ #1 yu. tena āvuso . 2 yu. ayaṃ pāṭho natthi . 3 ma. no . avibhattassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi . ākaṅkhamānā ca pana tumeha āyasmanto bhagavantaṃyeva upasaṅkamatha upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ
